ship_reason: PRE mean MAE macro 6.20 vs live/v1 6.61 (6.2% better), worse at 0/4 horizons; SHIP
planhc_note: not PRE-gated; a priori debt-brake / Sondervermögen pin; score-table residual only when macro ships

authority.open_year: open soll: Ausgaben × (80% hist + 20% YTD); Einnahmen × (95% hist + 5% YTD)
authority.later_primary: smly × (1 + w_sozial·0.35·wages[y−1]); w_sozial from BMF MB T1 Aufgabenbereiche (primary ex t1_zins)
authority.later_interest: debt-book annual[y−1] × carve month-share × FA stock YoY^Δy × (1 + 2.0·rates[y−1]/100)
authority.leaf_priors: a priori (Lohn/USt 1.0 NGDP, KSt 1.2, spend 1.0 CPI) — audit only

macro.source: AMECO/Eurostat nominal GDP YoY; IMF WEO / Eurostat HICP; Eurostat namq D1 wages; Finanzagentur stock + debt-book effective interest rate

drivers.ngdp: nominal GDP YoY (Steuerabschätzung activity base; proxy for wages/profits/VAT)
drivers.cpi: CPI / HICP (audit leaf prior on spend; production later primary CPI β=0)
drivers.wages: Eurostat namq_10_gdp D1 compensation-of-employees YoY (T1 sozial overlay)
drivers.employment: Eurostat namq_10_pe EMP_DC — tried on T1 sozial; PRE clears, OOS does not beat wages
drivers.fa_stock: Finanzagentur total federal debt stock YoY (compounds later-year interest level)

authority.plan_json: special funds only (no PRE-clearing macro driver)
authority.bmf_mb_tables: T0 Bundeshaushalt totals (used); T1 Aufgabenbereiche (sozial share × wages); T2 ökonomische Arten (spend leaves); T3 Steuerarten (tax leaves); no Sondervermögen tables in HTML set
authority.benchmark: live core = v1 bottom_up Soll×hist-ratio then smly

rejects: Leaf Soll×ratio open-year (unscaled) — PRE MAE ~4× worse than aggregate Soll pin
Leaf month-shares on aggregate Soll pin — PRE edge 4.2% (<5%)
Scaled leaf Steuerarten renormalized to annual Soll/Ist pin — no-op on cumulative MAE (rest-of-year totals match pin; CORE leaves fire on ≤20% of PRE windows)
Later-year Σ category smly — worse than v1 aggregate smly (coverage/residual)
Later-year category×NGDP/CPI OLS elasticity — unfit on PRE (Steuerarten from 2017; need ≥6 years)
Pure YTD Ist/Soll ratio (w=1) — PRE mean ~2× worse than hist
Equal open YTD w=0.15 + later primary CPI β=0.5 — cleared PRE but OOS 8.89 vs 7.54 for asymmetric/β_p=0
Later-year primary CPI β∈{0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} — PRE-ok subset; all worse OOS than β=0
Primary later on NGDP instead of CPI — no OOS gain over CPI grid once β_p=0
Interest smly×rates bi=1 — cleared; coupon×FA-stock bi∈{0…2} better OOS (ship bi=2)
BMF Zinsausgaben leaf as interest — PRE fails (~−60% edge)
Special-fund borrowing drivers — SVIK/SVBw zero in PRE; FMS/WSF flat beats smly OOS but no PRE-clearing driver for plan funds; plan.json annuals only
T1 Σ category smly / free-level paths — PRE fails or worse≤1 violated; renorm-to-primary annual pin = cumulative MAE no-op (OOS ties prior ship)
T1 sozial×employment overlay — PRE clears but OOS ≥7.45 (no beat vs coupon×stock ship)
T1 sozial×NGDP / rest×CPI overlays — PRE clears; OOS worse than wages β=0.35
T1 sozial×wages β=1.0 — PRE +6.7% but OOS 7.54 > 7.45 prior
Aggregate YoY NGDP/CPI on revenue/primary without open-year blend — loses/ties PRE
Monthly SARIMAX + HICP/NGDP — not selected on PRE (v1 note)
